title.narrative: GARR - Nexus Bridge Funding for Reimbursements and Project Closure Activities

description.narrative:
GARR has been a key implementing partner in the recently concluded Nexus project . As the project reaches its end phase, outstanding reimbursement claims from GARR and necessary administrative and technical closure activities remain unfunded due to delays in final disbursements. To avoid reputational risk, ensure compliance with contractual obligations, and support an orderly closure process including reporting, lessons-learned documentation, and knowledge capitalization, this bridge fund will provide limited financial coverage. The project specific objectives are : - - Reimburse GARR for all validated expenses incurred during the final phase of project implementation. - - Facilitate final project closure activities including reporting, evaluation, archiving, and knowledge sharing. - - Cover minimal operational and human resource costs directly related to close-out. Key activities : A1. Reimbursement to GARR: Transfer of approved reimbursable costs to GARR based on final financial statements and validation process. A2. Final Narrative and Financial Reporting: Compilation and submission of required final reports to donors and stakeholders. A3. Human Resources Close-Out: payment of short-term contracts or consultant fees to finalize documentation, finance, and M&E tasks. A4. Knowledge Capitalization: Conduct a lessons-learned workshop in both project areas of implementation A5. Administrative Closure: Archiving of project files, inventory reconciliation, and closure of accounts. Expected Results - - GARR fully reimbursed in compliance with contractual terms. - - All required reports completed and submitted. - - Closure of project accounts finalized. - - Key lessons documented and shared internally or externally as appropriate.
- - No outstanding liabilities at project end.
